🔐 Puzzle 1 — The Capital Lock

I am the city where Qatar’s government and major business districts are found. My name has 4 letters and begins with D. What am I?
Hint: Think of Qatar’s capital city.

🧩 Puzzle 2 — Scramble the Landmark

Unscramble these letters to find a famous Qatar cultural destination:

F • Q • A • T • A • K • R • A
Hint: It is a cultural village in Doha.

🗺️ Puzzle 3 — The Missing Landmark

Three landmarks are listed, but one does not belong to Qatar. Which one is the intruder?

Souq Waqif   •   Alhambra   •   Museum of Islamic Art
Hint: Two are famous places in Qatar; one is in Spain.

🐪 Puzzle 4 — The Desert Riddle

I am Qatar’s national animal. I can survive in hot, dry environments, and my name contains the word oryx. Who am I?
Hint: I am a species of antelope.

🇶🇦 Puzzle 5 — The Flag Cipher

Use this simple cipher: A=1, B=2, C=3 ... Z=26.

Decode: 17 – 1 – 20 – 1 – 18

What Qatar-related word do you get?
Hint: Convert each number into its matching letter.

🎉 JABAL UNLOCKED!
